WHO IS LWK?

LWK • KVGD

LWK CLAN

LWK is one of the biggest and most recognized clans in Knife vs Gun Duels.

The clan is home to many top players, experienced fighters, and highly skilled members from the Knife vs Gun Duels community. LWK has built a strong reputation through its active and competitive members.

With 100+ members, LWK has a large and active community. The clan also includes many rich and experienced players who own valuable items and have spent a lot of time playing and trading in Knife vs Gun Duels.

Whether you're looking for skilled players, competitive duels, experienced traders, or simply want to learn more about the LWK community, LWK is a well-known part of the Knife vs Gun Duels scene.
